title: A ruling answered on the waiting page always reaches its roadmap step
why: Incident, Nov 1 17:35 CST: the owner ruled on Oct 28 to keep the GitHub apps (page item 9), but step c153's note never got it, so triage asked again (item 145).
note: Shape: the roadmap build lists each closed page item whose answer is not on its home step, in the upkeep list triage reads each pass. Cost: one page read per roadmap build; no new process. Guard basis: named incident (Nov 1). Ready: no open question.
